Ruling (seat discretion — the card leaves this to the taker):
- (a) positive pin is mandatory, for every commit string `BASELINE` and `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` actually carry (the per-chunk constant carries more than one), each required to appear in the doc block attached to its own constant.
- (b) negative pin ships only if it is scoped to that attached block and the dev shows, by ablation, that it goes red on the #6778 shape (a retired hash in that block) while today's file stays green. Measured on `origin/main` today: the block attached to `BASELINE` (`:266`) already names the previous baseline `bd2a7ec50` at `:273` as history, so an unmarked (b) is red on the honest file before any mutation. If no marker is found that keeps that history legal without hiding a stale current-hash, ship (a) alone and record the measurement of which past-tense hashes sit in each attached block in the PR body. Neither a marker nor (b) is worth a rewrite of the narrative comments.

Checked against the card and the claim:

- File surface: one file, `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` (+217). (a) alone ships, plus the claim pin.
- Two seat assumptions were falsified by measurement and both are declared rather than worked around: `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` carries zero commit strings (the ruling assumed more than one), which is exactly why the per-constant pin could not have caught #6778 and the claim pin is the leg that does; and `BASELINE`'s leading JSDoc carries no hash — the sentence lives on the `gzipBytes` field comment inside the literal. On the open question: **A, keep the shipped scope** (leading JSDoc plus inner comments, code side excluded). It is structural with no line numbers, which was the ruling's intent; B would edit the prose the ruling said not to rewrite; C drops the mandatory half of (a). Excluding the `commit:` line from the prose side is the right call — the constant restating itself is this card's defect one layer up.
- Ablation: five legs on the real file under a trap, mutation proven by count and blob, restore proven by blob equality and an empty diff; A4 proves the locator reads the real block (control terms verified before assertion, neighbours excluded), A5 proves the module side is live. The refused A3 first attempt (a walk that would have moved the constant's own key) is the kind of process note worth keeping.
- Gates: targeted vitest 87/87, the five files naming the gate 197/197, type-check, control-bytes, entry-guard, changeset-presence (none owed, scripts-only), eslint on the file. Declared narrowing: the whole `scripts/__tests__` directory was not run locally (verify lock contended); CI runs it.
